UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user profile within the system, including their role and permissions.

Client.title: Client
Client.description: Represents a client company or individual for whom services are performed.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Client entity.

clientType.description: Indicates if the client is a company or a natural person.

name.description: The common or business name of the client.

legalName.description: The official legal name of the client (Razón Social).

taxId.description: The identification number of the client (RUC or DNI).

industry.description: The business sector or industry (Giro del negocio).

phone.description: The primary contact phone number for the client.

email.description: The primary contact email address for the client.

billingAddressLine1.description: The first line of the client's primary billing address.

billingCity.description: The city of the client's primary billing address.

billingState.description: The state or province of the client's primary billing address.

billingZipCode.description: The postal code of the client's primary billing address.

billingCountry.description: The country of the client's primary billing address.

notes.description: General notes or comments about the client.

ContactPerson.title: ContactPerson
ContactPerson.description: Represents an individual contact person associated with a client.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ContactPerson entity.

firstName.description: The first name of the contact person.

lastName.description: The last name of the contact person.

position.description: The job title or role of the contact person.

email.description: The email address of the contact person.

phone.description: The phone number of the contact person.

isPrimary.description: Indicates if this is the primary contact for the client.

ServiceLocation.title: ServiceLocation
ServiceLocation.description: Represents a physical location where services are performed for a client.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ServiceLocation entity.

name.description: A descriptive name for the service location (e.g., 'Main Office', 'Warehouse A').

addressLine1.description: The first line of the service location's address.

city.description: The city of the service location.

state.description: The state or province of the service location.

zipCode.description: The postal code of the service location.

country.description: The country of the service location.

notes.description: General notes or comments about the service location.

ServiceType.title: ServiceType
ServiceType.description: Defines the different types of services offered (e.g., Extinguisher Inspection, Fumigation, Refill).

Technician.title: Technician
Technician.description: Represents a technician responsible for performing services.

ServiceAppointment.title: ServiceAppointment
ServiceAppointment.description: Represents a scheduled and completed service appointment.

definition.description: User profiles for Servifumiga Pro employees.
